blocks.text: Last week's tag was nine dollars and seventy three cents. Today's item figure $2.94 is the real drop, and it will not rise later.
You are on www.marigold.example, the shop you opened.
The form at Marigold wants plastic digits, the month and year, and the short code on the back. It does not ask for a bank site secret.
The label count is the amount you receive.

The amount due includes that printed amount and matches the earlier quote.
Copper rivet at $3.56 is not ticked and is outside the amount due.
